Aradhana Mishra Appointed UP Congress Chief, Imran Masood Executive President

The Uttar Pradesh Congress Committee has appointed Aradhana Mishra as its new president, replacing Ajay Rai. Imran Masood has been appointed as the working president. This move is seen by some as an attempt to balance Brahmin and Muslim communities within the party's strategy in Uttar Pradesh.
